assessment: This study provides important new insights into the molecular regulation of adipocyte differentiation. Two molecules, TIS7 and SKMc15, are shown to regulate the activity of the key transcriptional regulator DLK-1 via discrete mechanisms – one involving transcription and the other translation. These findings add valuable information to the well known roles of Wnt/catenin and PPARg on adipocyte differentiation and will provide an advance for those interested in the role of adipocytes in whole body metabolism.
